episodes.title: The Night Train
episodes.scene_zh: 公司派你去爱丁堡艺术节做两周设计。你坐上了伦敦开往苏格兰的卧铺夜车。

lines.en: Mind if I sit here? The lounge car is always packed on Fridays.
lines.zh: 介意我坐这儿吗？周五的休息车厢总是挤满了人。

lines.en: Not at all. Is it always this busy?
lines.zh: 一点也不介意。一直这么忙吗？

lines.en: In August, yes. Half of London is heading north for the festival.
lines.zh: 八月就是这样。半个伦敦的人都往北去看艺术节。

lines.en: That's why I'm going too. My company is sending me to design posters for a theatre.
lines.zh: 我也是为这个去的。公司派我去给一家剧院设计海报。

lines.en: A designer! I'm Callum, by the way. I run walking tours in the Old Town.
lines.zh: 设计师！对了，我叫 Callum。我在老城带徒步游。

lines.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Lin. Is this your first time on the sleeper train?
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。我是林。你是第一次坐卧铺车吗？

lines.en: Far from it. I take it every month to visit my sister. You fall asleep in London and wake up in Scotland.
lines.zh: 远不止。我每个月都坐它去看我姐姐。在伦敦睡着，在苏格兰醒来。

lines.en: That sounds magical. I hope I can actually sleep, though. I'm a bit nervous about the job.
lines.zh: 听起来很神奇。不过希望我真能睡着。这份工作让我有点紧张。

lines.en: Why's that?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: The producer is American, and I've heard he changes his mind every five minutes.
lines.zh: 制作人是美国人，我听说他五分钟就改一次主意。

lines.en: Then you'll fit right in. Edinburgh in August is pure chaos.
lines.zh: 那你会很适应的。八月的爱丁堡就是一团乱。

lines.en: Great. Do you know a café called Sophie's Kitchen? A friend told me to go there.
lines.zh: 太好了。你知道一家叫 Sophie's Kitchen 的店吗？有个朋友叫我去那儿。

lines.en: Sophie's? Everyone knows Sophie's. But I heard it might be closing soon.
lines.zh: Sophie's？谁都知道。不过我听说它可能快关门了。

quiz.q: 你为什么去爱丁堡？
Callum 是做什么的？
Callum 听说 Sophie's Kitchen 怎么了？

episodes.next_zh: 第二天一早，你推开了 Sophie's Kitchen 的门。

episodes.title: Sophie's Kitchen
episodes.scene_zh: 你第一次见到 Sophie 本人。她的小餐会遇到了麻烦。

lines.en: Lin! You actually came. I've been looking forward to this since the reading night.
lines.zh: 林！你真的来了。读书夜之后我一直盼着这天。

lines.en: Me too. This place is lovely. It smells amazing in here.
lines.zh: 我也是。这里真好。闻起来太香了。

lines.en: That's the soup for tonight's supper club. Twelve strangers, one long table.
lines.zh: 那是今晚小餐会的汤。十二个陌生人，一张长桌。

lines.en: Callum told me you might be closing. Is that true?
lines.zh: Callum 说你可能要关门了。是真的吗？

lines.en: Unfortunately, yes. The building has been sold, and the new owners want to turn it into flats.
lines.zh: 很遗憾，是的。这栋楼卖掉了，新房东想改成公寓。

lines.en: That's awful. How long have you got?
lines.zh: 太糟了。你还有多久？

lines.en: Until the end of the festival. After that, I'll have to find somewhere else, or give up.
lines.zh: 到艺术节结束。之后要么找别的地方，要么放弃。

lines.en: You can't give up. People come here because of you, not because of the building.
lines.zh: 你不能放弃。大家是为你来的，不是为这栋楼。

lines.en: That's kind of you to say. Anyway, enough about me. Tell me about your theatre job.
lines.zh: 你这么说真好。好了，别说我了。说说你剧院的工作吧。

lines.en: I start tomorrow. I have to finish three posters in five days.
lines.zh: 我明天开始。五天要做完三张海报。

lines.en: Then you'll need feeding. Come to the supper club tonight. It's on the house.
lines.zh: 那你得吃好。今晚来小餐会吧，我请客。

lines.en: Only if you let me help with the washing-up afterwards.
lines.zh: 那你得让我饭后帮忙洗碗才行。

quiz.q: Sophie 的店为什么可能关门？
你要在五天里做完什么？
Sophie 邀请你今晚做什么？

episodes.next_zh: 第一天上班，制作人 Jake 让你彻底懵了。

episodes.title: First Floor, Second Thoughts
episodes.scene_zh: 剧院第一天。美国制作人 Jake 说的英语和你在伦敦学的不太一样。

lines.en: You must be Lin! Great to have you. Our office is on the first floor, just up the stairs.
lines.zh: 你一定是林！太好了。我们办公室在“一楼”，上楼梯就是。

lines.en: Up the stairs? In London, the first floor is the one above the ground floor.
lines.zh: 上楼梯？在伦敦，“first floor”是地面层上面那层。

lines.en: Right, I keep forgetting. For me, the first floor is the ground floor. Welcome to the confusion.
lines.zh: 对，我老忘。对我来说一楼就是地面层。欢迎来到混乱现场。

lines.en: So, what do you have in mind for the posters?
lines.zh: 那么，海报你有什么想法？

lines.en: Something bold. Bright colors, big faces, maybe a bit of fire.
lines.zh: 要大胆。鲜艳的颜色，大大的人脸，也许来点火焰。

lines.en: Fire? I thought the play was a quiet love story.
lines.zh: 火焰？我以为这部戏是个安静的爱情故事。

lines.en: It is. But quiet doesn't sell tickets. Trust me, I've been doing this for twenty years.
lines.zh: 是啊。可安静卖不出票。相信我，我干这行二十年了。

lines.en: I understand. Could I show you two versions, one bold and one closer to the story?
lines.zh: 我明白。我能给你看两个版本吗？一个大胆的，一个更贴近故事的？

lines.en: Sure, as long as they're on my desk by Wednesday.
lines.zh: 行，只要周三前放到我桌上就好。

lines.en: Wednesday? I thought the deadline was Friday.
lines.zh: 周三？我以为截止是周五。

lines.en: It was. Then the printer called. Sorry, that's festival life.
lines.zh: 原来是。后来印刷厂打电话了。抱歉，艺术节就是这样。

lines.en: No problem. I'll work late tonight.
lines.zh: 没问题。我今晚加班。

quiz.q: 对 Jake 来说，first floor 指哪层？
Jake 想要什么样的海报？
截止日期为什么提前了？

episodes.next_zh: 熬夜两天，周三一早，Jake 看着两版海报沉默了很久……

episodes.title: Arthur's Seat
episodes.scene_zh: 交稿后的周末，Callum 带你去爬爱丁堡市中心的那座山。

lines.en: Almost there! The view from the top is worth every step, I promise.
lines.zh: 快到了！山顶的风景绝对值得，我保证。

lines.en: You said that twenty minutes ago. My legs disagree.
lines.zh: 你二十分钟前就这么说了。我的腿不同意。

lines.en: Ha! So, how did the producer like your posters?
lines.zh: 哈！那制作人觉得你的海报怎么样？

lines.en: He chose the quiet one, which surprised me. He said it made him want to see the play.
lines.zh: 他选了安静的那版，让我挺意外的。他说那版让他想去看这部戏。

lines.en: Good for you. Sometimes people need to see the right answer before they know it's right.
lines.zh: 干得好。有时候人得先看到对的答案，才知道它是对的。

lines.en: That's very wise for someone who's out of breath.
lines.zh: 对一个喘不过气的人来说，这话挺有智慧。

lines.en: Here we are. On a clear day, you can see all the way to the sea.
lines.zh: 到了。天晴的时候，能一直看到海。

lines.en: Wow. It's beautiful. How's your tour business going, by the way?
lines.zh: 哇，真美。对了，你的导游生意怎么样？

lines.en: Honestly, not great. Everyone just follows the big companies with the umbrellas and microphones.
lines.zh: 说实话，不太好。大家都跟着那些举伞拿麦克风的大公司走。

lines.en: But your stories are much better than theirs. I've heard you on the train.
lines.zh: 可你讲的故事比他们好多了。我在火车上听过。

lines.en: Stories don't pay the rent, unfortunately.
lines.zh: 可惜，故事交不了房租。

lines.en: In London, they did. Let me tell you about a bookshop and a reading night.
lines.zh: 在伦敦，故事交上了房租。我给你讲讲一家书店和一个读书夜的事吧。

quiz.q: Jake 最后选了哪版海报？
天晴时从山顶能看到什么？
Callum 的生意为什么不好？

episodes.next_zh: 首演之夜到了，第二天早上的一篇评论让所有人都笑不出来。

episodes.title: One Star
episodes.scene_zh: 剧院首演后的第二天早上，报纸上的评论只给了一颗星。

lines.en: One star. One single star. "Beautiful posters, shame about the play."
lines.zh: 一颗星。就一颗星。“海报很美，戏可惜了。”

lines.en: At least they liked the posters? Sorry, that wasn't helpful.
lines.zh: 至少他们喜欢海报？抱歉，这话没什么用。

lines.en: Actually, it's the only good thing anyone has said all week.
lines.zh: 其实这是整个星期唯一一句好话。

lines.en: What did the reviewer not like about the play?
lines.zh: 评论员不喜欢这部戏的哪一点？

lines.en: He said it felt cold and distant, like watching people through a window.
lines.zh: 他说它冷冰冰、有距离感，像隔着窗户看人。

lines.en: Maybe the audience needs to feel closer to the actors before the show starts.
lines.zh: 也许观众需要在开演前就和演员亲近一些。

lines.en: Go on. What are you thinking?
lines.zh: 说下去。你在想什么？

lines.en: What if the audience had dinner with the cast before the performance? Like a supper club.
lines.zh: 要是观众在演出前和演员一起吃顿饭呢？像小餐会那样。

lines.en: Dinner with the cast? That's either brilliant or completely crazy.
lines.zh: 和演员一起吃饭？这要么是天才，要么是彻底疯了。

lines.en: I know someone who does exactly that. And she's about to lose her kitchen.
lines.zh: 我认识一个人正好就是做这个的。而且她马上就要失去她的厨房了。

lines.en: Set up a meeting. Today, if possible. We have two weeks left to save this show.
lines.zh: 约个见面。可能的话就今天。我们只剩两周来救这部戏。

quiz.q: 评论员给了几颗星？
评论员觉得这部戏有什么问题？
你的点子是什么？
options: 演出前观众和演员一起吃饭

episodes.next_zh: Sophie 愿意吗？你还得先过她姨妈 Morag 这一关。

episodes.title: Aunt Morag
episodes.scene_zh: 你和 Sophie 去找她的姨妈 Morag。她拥有城里一座老教堂改成的大厅。

lines.en: So you want to feed sixty strangers in my hall every night for two weeks?
lines.zh: 所以你们想在我的大厅里，连续两周每晚喂饱六十个陌生人？

lines.en: When you put it like that, it does sound a bit ambitious.
lines.zh: 你这么一说，听起来确实有点野心太大。

lines.en: We'd take care of everything, Mrs Mackenzie. Cleaning, tables, the lot.
lines.zh: Mackenzie 太太，所有事我们都包了。打扫、桌子，全部。

lines.en: Call me Morag, dear. Mrs Mackenzie was my mother-in-law, and she was terrifying.
lines.zh: 叫我 Morag 就好，亲爱的。Mackenzie 太太是我婆婆，她可吓人了。

lines.en: Morag, then. The theatre would pay for the hall, and Sophie would cook.
lines.zh: 那就 Morag。剧院出场地费，Sophie 来做饭。

lines.en: And what happens to the hall after the festival? It's been empty for three years.
lines.zh: 那艺术节之后这个大厅怎么办？它已经空了三年了。

lines.en: Honestly, I'd love to stay. It could be a permanent home for the supper club.
lines.zh: 说实话，我很想留下来。它可以成为小餐会的长期据点。

lines.en: Now that is something I could get excited about. This hall needs people in it.
lines.zh: 这倒是能让我兴奋起来的事。这个大厅需要有人气。

lines.en: Does that mean yes?
lines.zh: 这是答应了吗？

lines.en: It means yes, on one condition. On the last night, you hold a proper ceilidh.
lines.zh: 是答应了，但有一个条件。最后一晚，你们要办一场正宗的凯利舞会。

lines.en: A ceilidh? I'm sorry, I don't know that word.
lines.zh: Ceilidh？抱歉，我不知道这个词。

lines.en: It's a Scottish dance party. Don't worry, nobody knows the steps after the second song.
lines.zh: 是苏格兰的舞会。别担心，第二首歌之后谁都记不住舞步。

quiz.q: Morag 的大厅空了多久？
谁来做饭？
Morag 的条件是什么？

episodes.next_zh: 大厅有了，可是 Jake 那边的投资人还没点头。你要去做一次正式的提案。

episodes.title: The Pitch
episodes.scene_zh: 你在投资人面前介绍“戏前晚餐”的计划。Jake 坐在旁边，比你还紧张。

lines.en: Thank you for coming. I'll keep this short, because I know you're all busy.
lines.zh: 谢谢各位来。我长话短说，我知道大家都很忙。

lines.en: Our play received one star, mainly because the audience felt disconnected from the characters.
lines.zh: 我们的戏只拿到一颗星，主要因为观众觉得和角色之间有隔阂。

lines.en: Our solution is simple: before each show, the audience shares a meal with the cast.
lines.zh: 我们的办法很简单：每场演出前，观众和演员一起吃饭。

lines.en: The actors stay in character during dinner, so the story actually starts at the table.
lines.zh: 演员吃饭时保持角色身份，所以故事其实从餐桌就开始了。

lines.en: The meal is cooked by Sophie Grant, whose supper clubs sell out every week.
lines.zh: 饭由 Sophie Grant 来做，她的小餐会每周都爆满。

lines.en: Tickets would cost more, but our research suggests people will pay for an experience they can't get anywhere else.
lines.zh: 票价会更高，但我们的调查显示，人们愿意为别处得不到的体验付钱。

lines.en: We've already tested it with twenty people. Eighteen said they'd recommend it to a friend.
lines.zh: 我们已经找二十个人试过了。十八个人说会推荐给朋友。

lines.en: We're asking for enough money to cover the hall and the food for two weeks. Any questions?
lines.zh: 我们申请的金额够付两周的场地和食材。有什么问题吗？

lines.en: Nobody's saying anything. Is that good or bad?
lines.zh: 没人说话。这是好事还是坏事？

lines.en: In my experience, silence usually means they're doing the maths.
lines.zh: 按我的经验，安静通常说明他们在算账。

lines.en: Look, the woman at the end is smiling. I think we just did it.
lines.zh: 看，最边上那位女士在笑。我觉得我们成了。

quiz.q: 戏只拿一颗星的主要原因是什么？
options: 观众觉得和角色有隔阂

quiz.q: 试吃的二十个人里，多少人愿意推荐？
你认为投资人安静说明什么？

episodes.next_zh: 钱到位了。可第一场“戏前晚餐”那天，天气预报说有暴雨……

episodes.title: Rain on the Royal Mile
episodes.scene_zh: 第一场戏前晚餐前三小时，暴雨把通往大厅的街道淹了一半。

lines.en: Half of the Royal Mile is under water. The police have closed the bottom end of the street.
lines.zh: 皇家一英里一半都淹了。警察封了街道的下半段。

lines.en: But sixty people are supposed to walk from the theatre to the hall in three hours.
lines.zh: 可是三小时后六十个人要从剧院走到大厅。

lines.en: Not that way, they're not. Unless they fancy swimming.
lines.zh: 走那条路可不行。除非他们想游泳。

lines.en: Is there another route? You know these streets better than anyone.
lines.zh: 有别的路吗？这些街道你比谁都熟。

lines.en: There's a covered passage through the old closes. It's narrow and dark, but it stays dry.
lines.zh: 穿过老巷子有一条有顶的通道。又窄又暗，但淋不着雨。

lines.en: Narrow and dark sounds perfect for a play about secrets.
lines.zh: 又窄又暗，对一部讲秘密的戏来说太完美了。

lines.en: Are you suggesting what I think you're suggesting?
lines.zh: 你是在说我想的那个意思吗？

lines.en: You lead the audience through the closes and tell them the history on the way. The walk becomes part of the show.
lines.zh: 你带观众穿过小巷，路上给他们讲历史。这段路就变成演出的一部分。

lines.en: A tour, a dinner and a play in one evening. Jake will either love it or fire us both.
lines.zh: 一晚上有导游、晚餐和戏。Jake 要么爱死它，要么把我们俩都开了。

lines.en: He can't fire you. You don't work for him. Yet.
lines.zh: 他开不了你，你又不是他的员工。暂时还不是。

lines.en: Right. Give me ten minutes to find some torches, and we're in business.
lines.zh: 好。给我十分钟找几个手电筒，咱们就开工。

quiz.q: 暴雨造成了什么问题？
Callum 知道哪条路？
options: 穿过老巷子的有顶通道

quiz.q: 你的新主意是什么？
options: 让这段路变成演出的一部分

episodes.next_zh: 那一晚之后，城里开始有人议论“雨夜里的那条小巷”。

episodes.title: A Call from London
episodes.scene_zh: 演出越来越火。深夜，Emma 从伦敦打来视频电话。

lines.en: Lin! I've just read about your show in the newspaper. Four stars! Why didn't you tell me?
lines.zh: 林！我刚在报纸上看到你们的戏了。四颗星！你怎么都不告诉我？

lines.en: Because I haven't slept properly in a week. It's been absolutely mad up here.
lines.zh: 因为我一个星期都没好好睡过觉。这边简直疯了。

lines.en: The article mentions a tour guide, a supper club and a designer from London. That's you!
lines.zh: 文章里提到一个导游、一个小餐会，还有一位来自伦敦的设计师。那就是你！

lines.en: I just connected people who needed each other. They did the hard work.
lines.zh: 我只是把彼此需要的人连在了一起。辛苦的是他们。

lines.en: That's exactly what you did with my bookshop. You're very good at it, you know.
lines.zh: 你对我的书店做的就是这件事。你知道吗，你特别擅长这个。

lines.en: How is the shop, by the way? I miss our kitchen.
lines.zh: 对了，书店怎么样？我想我们的厨房了。

lines.en: Busier than ever. Tom keeps asking when you're coming back, and Arthur has started baking for us.
lines.zh: 比以前都忙。Tom 一直问你什么时候回来，Arthur 开始给我们烤点心了。

lines.en: Tell them I'll be back next Sunday, unless something unexpected happens.
lines.zh: 告诉他们我下周日回去，除非出什么意外。

lines.en: Something unexpected always happens to you. That's why your life is never boring.
lines.zh: 你身上总会出意外。所以你的生活从来不无聊。

lines.en: Funny you should say that. Jake asked me to stay and work on his next show. In New York.
lines.zh: 你这么说真巧。Jake 请我留下来做他下一部戏。在纽约。

lines.en: New York?! Lin, you can't drop a bomb like that at midnight!
lines.zh: 纽约？！林，你不能半夜扔下这样一颗炸弹！

quiz.q: 报纸给了这部戏几颗星？
Emma 说你特别擅长什么？
options: 把彼此需要的人连在一起

quiz.q: Jake 邀请你去哪里？

episodes.next_zh: 最后一晚的凯利舞会上，你必须做出决定。

episodes.title: The Ceilidh
episodes.scene_zh: 艺术节最后一晚。Morag 的大厅里挤满了跳舞的人。

lines.en: Look at this hall! I haven't seen it this full since my wedding, and that was a long time ago.
lines.zh: 看看这个大厅！自从我结婚以后就没见它这么满过，那可是很久以前了。

lines.en: And it's staying full. Morag has agreed to rent it to me for the next five years.
lines.zh: 而且会一直这么满。Morag 同意把它租给我五年。

lines.en: And the theatre wants my tour as part of the show next year. I might actually be able to pay my rent.
lines.zh: 剧院还想明年把我的导游路线加进演出里。我说不定真能交上房租了。

lines.en: I'm so happy for you both. This is the best ending I could have imagined.
lines.zh: 真替你们俩高兴。这是我能想象到的最好的结局。

lines.en: It's not an ending if you come to New York. It's a sequel.
lines.zh: 如果你来纽约，这就不是结局，而是续集。

lines.en: Jake, I've thought about it a lot, and I'd love to say yes, but not right now.
lines.zh: Jake，我想了很多。我很想答应，但不是现在。

lines.en: Can I ask why? It's a big opportunity.
lines.zh: 能问为什么吗？这是个大机会。

lines.en: Because I've just started to feel at home in London, and I want to finish what I started there first.
lines.zh: 因为我才刚开始在伦敦有家的感觉，我想先把在那儿开始的事做完。

lines.en: Fair enough. The offer stands for a year. And I'm not good at taking no for an answer.
lines.zh: 合情合理。这个邀请一年内有效。而且我不太会接受别人拒绝。

lines.en: Enough talking! The band is starting the last dance, and nobody sits this one out.
lines.zh: 别聊了！乐队要奏最后一支舞了，这支谁都不许坐着。

lines.en: But I still don't know the steps!
lines.zh: 可我还是不会跳啊！

lines.en: Nobody does, Lin. That's the whole point. Come on!
lines.zh: 谁都不会，林。重点就在这儿。来吧！
